description: This file is a shell script (.sh) used for testing Git push.default settings and push workflows. It sets up repositories, defines testing functions, and runs various Git push scenarios to verify behavior under different configurations.

methods.name: check_pushed_commit
methods.description: Checks whether the last commit pushed to a specified revision matches the expected commit and message.

methods.name: test_push_success
methods.description: Tests a successful git push with specific 'push.default' setting.

methods.name: test_push_failure
methods.description: Ensures a git push fails under specific 'push.default' configurations and that local repository remains unchanged.

methods.name: test_pushdefault_workflow
methods.description: Tests push workflows with different 'push.default' settings and workflows (centralized vs triangular), verifying success or failure accordingly.
